title: Assam polls: Major Opposition leaders trailing in early trends
summary: Congress leader Saikia was trailing by 4,967 votes in Sivasagar district's Nazira seat. BJP’s Mayur Borgohain secured 11,607 votes after the second round, compared to Saikia’s 6,640

title: West Bengal election results LIVE: BJP inches towards majority mark in leads
summary: Counting of votes for the high-stakes Assembly elections is under way, with the verdict set to decide whether the Mamata Banerjee-led TMC returns to power for a fourth consecutive term or the BJP scripts history by forming its first government in the State

title: West Bengal polls: Situation ‘fishy’, say cautious TMC leaders as several candidates trail
summary: The trend triggered concern among TMC supporters, prompting party leaders to exercise caution in making claims of a landslide victory

title: Tamil Nadu Assembly election results 2026 LIVE: TVK leads in over 100 seats as CM Stalin, other DMK veterans trail
summary: TVK president Vijay leads in Tiruchi East and Perambur; Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is trailing in Kolathur as of 10.30 a.m.

title: Kerala Election Results 2026 LIVE: Congress-led UDF surges ahead as Left's last bastion slips out of its grip
summary: After the first few rounds of counting, UDF was leading in 100 of the 140 Assembly seats, while CPI(M)-led ruling LDF was ahead in just in 40 constituencies. The BJP-led NDA was leading in only one seat

title: Assam election results LIVE: NDA maintains lead in State; trends show party approaching majority mark
summary: Both alliances are gung-ho about bagging at least 64 seats, the simple majority mark in the 126-member Assembly

title: Portion of bridge over Ganga collapses in Bihar's Bhagalpur, no casualties
summary: As soon as officials received information about the gap between the two slabs, they acted promptly to remove all vehicles and people from the spot, says Bhagalpur District Magistrate Nawal Kishor Choudhary

title: Karnataka bypoll results: Congress party’s Umesh Meti leads in Bagalkot, BJP’s Srinivas Dasakariyappa in Davanagere South
summary: Congress candidate Umesh Meti leads by around 10,534 votes in the Bagalkot bypoll against BJP’s Veeranna Charantimath; in Davangere South, BJP’s Srinivas Dasakariyappa in lead by 3,925 votes against Samarth Mallikarjun of Congress.
